about: The Review sentence under the board (rev-why-txt) sets its lines no more than 17px apart, the height its box reserves per line (line height 1.3 on a phone, lower only where the font is over 13px). Gate 121 is run whole (about 7 minutes a try): at every one of the 85 plies of his game at 320x568 and at 761x375 (his phone turned sideways), TC-R118 holds the box no taller than the clamped lines and TC-R118b holds it no shorter than the lines it shows, so the clamp and never the box edge cuts. NOT COVERED, said rather than implied: 375-wide portrait is gate 120's (TC-R118 and TC-R118b there, not run by this pair); 812x375 and the 1440x900 desktop window were measured by hand (the probe in the job's outcome), not by a gate; the analysis board's sentence (anaMode, minHeight) and the engine and best line rows are not read; the gate browser's font is not his phone's.

breaks.name: sentence-lines-1-3
breaks.why: the line height goes back to 1.3 of the font, as before the change: sideways the 14.5px font sets lines 18.85 apart in a box of 34 for two, and the box edge cuts the second line's foot by 1.84px

breaks.name: sentence-box-short
breaks.why: the sideways box reserves 32px for its two lines of 17: the lines are right and the box cuts the second one by 2px

breaks.name: sentence-box-slack
breaks.why: line height 1.15: on a phone the 13px lines are 14.95 apart in boxes that reserve 17 a line, so the box is taller than the clamped lines and the next line paints its top into the slack under an ellipsis (CLAUDE.md, a clamp and a clip are two different boxes). Sideways the 14.5px lines are 16.675 and two fit their 34 within the 0.5px tolerance, so it is held only at 320x568
